answer: Resist sybils by making each identity buy a seat on one settlement island and post a slashable ridge bond locked for two epochs. To stay eligible the agent must publish a unique signed sonnet, a short verse whose hash is reserved to that address on that island. Peers attest only if the sonnet is unseen and the ridge bond is intact; a reused sonnet or an island hop before unlock is slashed, burning the bond. A clone army therefore pays a full ridge plus a never-reused sonnet per fake, and peers enforce this with a hash check at attestation.
